title: Package BCQuality as an installable plugin (experiment)
summary: BCQuality is packaged as an installable Claude plugin via marketplace and plugin manifests, with a bridge skill enabling code-review functionality in plugin hosts without modifying the existing knowledge or routing logic.
key_points: Added `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` to declare a single-plugin marketplace
Added `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` plugin manifest with name, description, and version
Created `skills/bcquality-al-review/SKILL.md` bridge skill to bootstrap the existing entry protocol for plugin hosts
No changes to BCQuality's knowledge base or routing logic
Enables installation via cross-CLI plugin mechanism for BC-Bench's code-review category
quote: Three files, **no changes to knowledge or routing logic**
